test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

You are an intellectual with a professional degree; you can do wonders as __________.
solution:
The correct answer is: '**the world is your oyster'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"the world is your oyster"** means that you can achieve anything you want in life or go anywhere because you have the opportunity or ability to do so. (आपके लिए सारी दुनिया अवसरों से भरी है)

 
 
• **Example:** With your talents and skills, **the world is your oyster**.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct idiom to fill the blank is the world is your oyster

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

**Complete Sentence:** *You are an intellectual with a professional degree; you can do wonders as the world is your oyster__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Playing with fire** (आग से खेलना): Doing something risky or dangerous.

 
 
• **Example:** By not following safety protocols, you are **playing with fire**.
 
 
 
• **You can say it again** (सौ बात की एक बात): Used to show strong agreement with what someone has said.
 
 
• **Example:** "This weather is just awful." "**You can say it again**!"
 
 
 
• **Your mileage may vary** (आपका अनुभव अलग हो सकता है): Used to indicate that results may vary between different people or situations.
 
 
• **Example:** This diet worked for me, but **your mileage may vary**.
